# Copula-based approach to candidate alpha-signal generation

A concept shared by **63** of the 14,225 algorithms in the [ranked algorithm list](../../algorithm_ledger.md#8c-the-ranked-algorithm-list-csv-import) (CSV import of 2026-10-27); its best-ranked member is #2,064. The CSV rates every member: *Low confidence — reconstructed from the algorithm title; executable rules and source support are not established.* None is implemented in volatility-ai.

## Description

Proposed copula-based approach to candidate alpha-signal generation: Use a diffusion-style generative model to propose or transform candidate market features/signals; each signal would still require independent out-of-sample validation and explicit trading rules. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
